SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.Date) AS Year, SUM(t.Consumption) AS Total_Consumption FROM yearmonth t WHERE t.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.Date) ORDER BY Total_Consumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT YEAR(Date) AS Year, SUM(Consumption) AS Total_Consumption FROM transactions_1k JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY YEAR(Date) ORDER BY Total_Consumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT YEAR(d.Date) AS Consumed_Year 
FROM transactions_1k t 
JOIN yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND t.Date = y.Date 
WHERE Currency = 'CZK' 
GROUP BY YEAR(d.Date) 
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT YEAR(y.Date) AS Year, SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption 
FROM yearmonth y 
JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID AND y.Date = t.Date 
WHERE Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY YEAR(y.Date) ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.Date) AS Year 
FROM yearmonth y JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
WHERE t.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM y.Date) ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1
